row.name: Glaukos Corporation Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=15 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=1 giveback=0.27 tightness=0.79 base_volume_vs_leg=0.68 base_volume_vs_avg=0.82
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close -5.1% vs its 20-SMA, -7.3% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 3 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The burst bar gains only 2.3% and the range expansion explicitly fails — it is not the widest bar of the last five sessions, which is the mechanical heart of the setup. Looking at the chart, the shaded base sits well below the prior August highs (~191), meaning the stock has already given back roughly 12–15% from its peak and the 'burst' is a weak bounce inside a visible downtrend from those highs, not a breakout from a tight shelf at highs. The base itself shows multiple wide overlapping red bars with the price drifting lower throughout, which is a downtrend with a bounce rather than an orderly consolidation.
claude.key_risk: The stock is in a declining channel from its August peak with the burst bar failing range expansion, making this a low-probability bounce rather than a momentum burst.
claude.entry_note: Skip if tomorrow opens below today's burst close of 171.09 or if the first 30 minutes show any continuation of the recent downward drift without a clear surge in volume.

row.summary: GKOS: +2.3% on 1.6× volume out of a base 13.0% deep. skip 10.0, 6 of 6 criteria.
